mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and nephrotoxic; amphotericin B causes dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and hepatotoxicity while isotretinoin causes hepatotoxicity and lipid abnormalities, resulting in additive organ toxicity.
action: Monitor liver and renal function tests closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure isotretinoin dosing is appropriate given potential compromised organ function; avoid concurrent use if clinically feasible.
